translations.idiomatic: On the appointed day he put on dragon robes and departed from the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 樂備不作。

translations.literal: Musicians were assembled but did not perform.
translations.idiomatic: Musicians were in readiness but did not play.

sentences.zh: 至廟內降輿。

translations.literal: At the temple he descended from the palanquin.
translations.idiomatic: He descended from the palanquin inside the temple precinct.

sentences.zh: 入中門，俟幄次，出盥畢，詣殿中拜位，二跪六拜。

translations.literal: Entering the central gate, he waited at the tent, then emerged after ablutions, proceeded to the bowing place in the hall, and performed two kowtows and six prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the central gate, waited at the tent, came out after ablutions, went to the bowing place in the hall, and performed two kowtows and six prostrations.

sentences.zh: 奠、獻如常儀。

translations.literal: Offerings and presentations followed the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of offerings followed the usual rite.

sentences.zh: 不飲福、受胙。

translations.literal: He did not drink the blessing wine or receive sacrificial meat.
translations.idiomatic: He did not drink the blessing wine or receive the sacrificial meat.

sentences.zh: 明年，復改祀北嶽、混同江。

translations.literal: The following year, worship of the Northern Peak and the Hun River was again relocated.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, sacrifice to the Northern Peak and the Hun River was again moved.

sentences.zh: 逾二年，始望祭。

translations.literal: More than two years later, distant sacrifice was first instituted.
translations.idiomatic: After more than two years, distant sacrifice was first established.

sentences.zh: 三十五年正月，為元元祈福，始遣大臣分行祭告，凡岳五：曰東嶽泰山、南嶽衡山、中嶽嵩山、西嶽華山，北嶽恆山。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirty-fifth year, to pray for the welfare of all the people, ministers were first dispatched in separate missions to offer sacrifice and announcement. The five peaks were: the Eastern Peak Mount Tai, the Southern Peak Mount Heng, the Central Peak Mount Song, the Western Peak Mount Hua, and the Northern Peak Mount Heng.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirty-fifth year, to pray for the welfare of all under Heaven, great ministers were first sent out in separate missions to sacrifice and announce. The five peaks were the Eastern Peak Mount Tai, the Southern Peak Mount Heng, the Central Peak Mount Song, the Western Peak Mount Hua, and the Northern Peak Mount Heng.

sentences.zh: 鎮五：曰東鎮沂山、南鎮會稽山、中鎮霍山、西鎮吳山、北鎮醫巫閭山。

translations.literal: The five guardian mountains: the Eastern Guardian Mount Yi, the Southern Guardian Mount Kuaiji, the Central Guardian Mount Huo, the Western Guardian Mount Wu, and the Northern Guardian Mount Yiwulü.
translations.idiomatic: The five guardian mountains were the Eastern Guardian Mount Yi, the Southern Guardian Mount Kuaiji, the Central Guardian Mount Huo, the Western Guardian Mount Wu, and the Northern Guardian Mount Yiwulü.

sentences.zh: 海四：曰東海、南海、西海、北海。

translations.literal: The four seas: the East Sea, South Sea, West Sea, and North Sea.
translations.idiomatic: The four seas were the East Sea, South Sea, West Sea, and North Sea.

sentences.zh: 瀆四：曰江瀆、淮瀆、濟瀆、河瀆。

translations.literal: The four great rivers: the Yangtze Spirit, Huai River Spirit, Ji River Spirit, and Yellow River Spirit.
translations.idiomatic: The four great rivers were the Yangtze Spirit, Huai Spirit, Ji Spirit, and Yellow River Spirit.

sentences.zh: 又兀喇長白山。

translations.literal: Also Mount Changbai in Wula.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Changbai in Wula was added as well.

sentences.zh: 翕河喬嶽自此始。

translations.literal: The collective worship of great rivers and lofty peaks began from this point.
translations.idiomatic: The unified dispatch of sacrifice to great rivers and lofty peaks began from this time.

sentences.zh: 明年，朔漠平，遣祭岳、鎮、海、瀆如故。

translations.literal: The following year, when the northern deserts were pacified, sacrifice to the peaks, guardian mountains, seas, and great rivers was dispatched as before.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, after the northern deserts were pacified, sacrifice to the peaks, guardian mountains, seas, and great rivers was dispatched as before.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，賜號江瀆曰涵和，河瀆曰潤毓，淮瀆曰通佑，濟瀆曰永惠。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng, titles were granted: the Yangtze Spirit was named Hanhe, the Yellow River Spirit Runyu, the Huai River Spirit Tongyou, and the Ji River Spirit Yonghui.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2, titles were granted: the Yangtze Spirit Hanhe (All-Embracing Harmony), the Yellow River Spirit Runyu (Moistening and Nurturing), the Huai Spirit Tongyou (Universal Aid), and the Ji Spirit Yonghui (Lasting Grace).

sentences.zh: 並賜東海為顯仁，南為昭明，西為正恆，北為崇禮。

translations.literal: Titles were also granted to the seas: the East Sea as Xianren, the South as Zhaoming, the West as Zhengheng, and the North as Chongli.
translations.idiomatic: The seas were also granted titles: the East Sea Xianren (Manifest Benevolence), the South Zhaoming (Bright Illumination), the West Zhengheng (Correct Constancy), and the North Chongli (Honored Rite).

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，封泰寧山曰永寧，附祀地壇如故事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong, Mount Taining was enfeoffed as Yongning and attached for collateral sacrifice at the Earth Spirits Altar according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 2, Taining Mountain was enfeoffed as Yongning (Enduring Tranquility) and attached for collateral sacrifice at the Earth Spirits Altar according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 越十年，以來歲奉太后秩岱宗，敕群臣議禮。

translations.literal: Ten years later, because the Empress Dowager would be brought to Mount Tai the following year, the emperor ordered the ministers to deliberate on the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Ten years later, with the Empress Dowager scheduled to be brought to Mount Tai the following year, the emperor ordered the ministers to deliberate on the rite.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「古者因名山以升中，有燔柴禮。

translations.literal: They memorialized: "In antiquity one ascended the central peak by way of a famous mountain, and there was the rite of burning firewood.
translations.idiomatic: They reported: "In antiquity rulers ascended a famous mountain to reach the central peak, and there was the rite of burning firewood upon it.

sentences.zh: 聖祖因儀文度數，書缺有閒，議封禪者多不經。

translations.literal: The Sage Ancestor, considering the degrees and measures of ritual text, found gaps in the records, and held that discussions of the Feng and Shan rites were mostly unsound.
translations.idiomatic: The Sage Ancestor, weighing the degrees and measures of ritual text against what the records preserved, found lacunae in the sources and judged most proposals for the Feng and Shan rites to be unsound.

sentences.zh: 定以祀五嶽禮致祭，允宜遵行。」

translations.literal: He ordained that sacrifice should be performed according to the rite for the Five Sacred Peaks — this should properly be followed."
translations.idiomatic: He fixed sacrifice according to the rite for the Five Sacred Peaks, and this was properly approved for observance."

sentences.zh: 明年蒞泰安，前一日，詣岳廟三上香，一跪三拜。

translations.literal: The following year he arrived at Tai'an; one day beforehand he went to the peak temple, offered incense three times, and performed one kowtow and three prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he arrived at Tai'an; on the day before he went to the peak temple, offered incense three times, and performed one kowtow and three prostrations.

sentences.zh: 翼日祭，如聖祖祀岳儀。

translations.literal: On the following day he sacrificed according to the Sage Ancestor's rite for worshiping the sacred peak.
translations.idiomatic: On the following day he sacrificed according to the Sage Ancestor's rite for worship at the sacred peak.

sentences.zh: 又明年，巡省中州，祀中嶽，如初。

translations.literal: The year after that, on a tour of the Central Provinces, he sacrificed to the Central Peak as before.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that, touring the Central Provinces, he sacrificed to the Central Peak as before.

sentences.zh: 十六年，巡江、浙，遣祭江、淮、河神。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, on a tour of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, he dispatched officers to sacrifice to the Yangtze, Huai, and Yellow River spirits.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, while touring Jiangsu and Zhejiang, he dispatched officers to sacrifice to the Yangtze, Huai, and Yellow River spirits.

sentences.zh: 自是南巡凡六，皆躬祭。

translations.literal: From then on, of six southern tours in all, he personally performed sacrifice at each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, across six southern tours in all, he personally performed sacrifice each time.

sentences.zh: 十九年，巡吉林，望祭北鎮，長白山亦如之。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, on a tour of Jilin, he offered distant sacrifice to the Northern Guardian Mountain; Mount Changbai was treated the same way.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, touring Jilin, he offered distant sacrifice to the Northern Guardian Mountain; Mount Changbai was treated likewise.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，用禮臣議，改岳、鎮、海、瀆遣官六人，長白山、北海、北鎮一人，西嶽、西鎮、江瀆一人，東嶽、東鎮、東海、南鎮一人，中南二岳、濟淮二瀆一人，北嶽、中鎮、西海、河瀆一人，南海一人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, following the ritual officials' deliberation, dispatch for the peaks, guardian mountains, seas, and great rivers was changed to six officers: Mount Changbai, the North Sea, and the Northern Guardian Mountain one officer; the Western Peak, Western Guardian Mountain, and Yangtze Spirit one officer; the Eastern Peak, Eastern Guardian Mountain, East Sea, and Southern Guardian Mountain one officer; the Central and Southern peaks and the Ji and Huai river spirits one officer; the Northern Peak, Central Guardian Mountain, West Sea, and Yellow River Spirit one officer; and the South Sea one officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, on the ritual officials' recommendation, dispatch for the peaks, guardian mountains, seas, and great rivers was reorganized into six officers: one for Mount Changbai, the North Sea, and the Northern Guardian Mountain; one for the Western Peak, Western Guardian Mountain, and Yangtze Spirit; one for the Eastern Peak, Eastern Guardian Mountain, East Sea, and Southern Guardian Mountain; one for the Central and Southern peaks and the Ji and Huai spirits; one for the Northern Peak, Central Guardian Mountain, West Sea, and Yellow River Spirit; and one for the South Sea alone.

sentences.zh: 當是時，海神廟饗，所在多有，惟北海尚闕。

translations.literal: At that time, temples to sea spirits were found in many places, but the North Sea alone still lacked one.
translations.idiomatic: At that time temples to sea spirits existed in many places, but the North Sea alone still had none.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，始建山海關北海神廟。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year, the North Sea Spirit Temple at Shanhaiguan was first built.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year, the North Sea Spirit Temple at Shanhaiguan was first erected.

sentences.zh: 凡祈禱地壇行禮，位北階下，三跪九拜，用瘞。

translations.literal: Whenever sacrifice was performed at the Earth Spirits Altar for prayer, one stood below the northern steps, performed three kowtows and nine prostrations, and used the interment rite.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever prayer sacrifice was performed at the Earth Spirits Altar, the officiant stood below the northern steps, performed three kowtows and nine prostrations, and used the interment rite.

sentences.zh: 光緒初元，加太白山神曰保民，醫巫閭山神曰靈應。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Guangxu reign, the spirit of Mount Taibai was further titled Baomin, and the spirit of Mount Yiwulü Lingying.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Guangxu reign, the spirit of Mount Taibai received the further title Baomin (Protecting the People), and the spirit of Mount Yiwulü Lingying (Responsive Spirit).

sentences.zh: 二十七年，兩宮幸西安，遣官祭所過山川，並告祭華、嵩二岳，如禮。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, when both empresses dowager visited Xi'an, officers were dispatched to sacrifice to the mountains and rivers along the route, and to offer announcement sacrifice at Mount Hua and Mount Song according to rite.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, when both empresses dowager visited Xi'an, officers were dispatched to sacrifice to the mountains and rivers along the route and to offer announcement sacrifice at Mount Hua and Mount Song according to rite.

sentences.zh: 其他山川之祀，自聖祖北征朔漠，駐蹕噶爾圖，命大學士祭山川，出卡倫，命官祭域外山川。

translations.literal: For the worship of other mountains and rivers: from the time the Sage Ancestor campaigned north into the desert and halted at Ga'ertu, he ordered grand secretaries to sacrifice to mountains and rivers; when passing beyond the frontier posts, he ordered officers to sacrifice to mountains and rivers outside the realm.
translations.idiomatic: As for other mountain and river worship: from the time the Sage Ancestor marched north into the desert and halted at Ga'ertu, he ordered grand secretaries to sacrifice to mountains and rivers; beyond the frontier posts he ordered officers to sacrifice to mountains and rivers outside the realm.

sentences.zh: 自是浙江、大沽、大通海神皆建廟修祀。

translations.literal: From then on, temples were built and worship established for the sea spirits of Zhejiang, Dagu, and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter temples were built and worship established for the sea spirits of Zhejiang, Dagu, and Datong.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，建湘江神、武昌江神廟，並賜號廣東海陽山神曰安流襄績。

translations.literal: During the Yongzheng period, temples to the Xiang River spirit and the Wuchang River spirit were built, and the spirit of Mount Haiyang in Guangdong was granted the title Anliu Xiangji.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng period, temples to the Xiang River spirit and the Wuchang River spirit were built, and the spirit of Haiyang Mountain in Guangdong was granted the title Anliu Xiangji (Pacifying the Currents and Aiding Achievement).

sentences.zh: 高宗纘業，定星宿海、西域山川、伊犁阿布拉山諸神祀。

translations.literal: When the Gaozong Emperor succeeded, he established worship for the spirits of the Star Lake, the mountains and rivers of the Western Regions, and Mount Abola in Ili.
translations.idiomatic: When the Gaozong Emperor succeeded to the throne, he established worship for the spirits of the Star Lake, the mountains and rivers of the Western Regions, and Mount Abola in Ili.

sentences.zh: 又以松花江導源長白，依望祭北海制行。

translations.literal: Because the Songhua River flows from Mount Changbai, distant sacrifice was conducted according to the precedent for the North Sea.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Songhua River rises on Mount Changbai, distant sacrifice was conducted according to the North Sea precedent.

sentences.zh: 大軍西征，祭阿勒台、珠爾庫、博克達、阿拉克四山。

translations.literal: On the great western campaign, sacrifice was offered to the four mountains of Aletai, Zhuerku, Bokeda, and Alake.
translations.idiomatic: During the great western campaign, sacrifice was offered to the four mountains Aletai, Zhuerku, Bokeda, and Alake.

sentences.zh: 復賜太白山、洞庭山、庫倫汗山、金山諸神號。

translations.literal: Titles were further granted to the spirits of Mount Taibai, Mount Dongting, Mount Kulunhan, and Mount Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Titles were further granted to the spirits of Mount Taibai, Mount Dongting, Mount Kulunhan, and Mount Jin.

sentences.zh: 川、陝平，建終南山神廟。

translations.literal: When Sichuan and Shaanxi were pacified, a temple to the spirit of Mount Zhongnan was built.
translations.idiomatic: After Sichuan and Shaanxi were pacified, a temple to the spirit of Mount Zhongnan was built.

sentences.zh: 木蘭秋獮，議定興安大嶺山祀典，常祭用少牢，告祭太牢，歲仲春望祭行禮，如祀五鎮儀。

translations.literal: During the autumn hunt at Mulan, the sacrificial canon for Mount Xing'an Daling was deliberated and fixed: regular sacrifice used the lesser complete victim; announcement sacrifice used the grand complete victim; each year in mid-spring distant sacrifice was performed according to the rite for the five guardian mountains.
translations.idiomatic: During the autumn hunt at Mulan, the sacrificial canon for Mount Xing'an Daling was fixed: regular sacrifice used the lesser complete victim, announcement sacrifice the grand complete victim, and each mid-spring distant sacrifice followed the rite for the five guardian mountains.

sentences.zh: 帛、尊、羊、豕各一，簠、簋各二，爵三，籩、豆各十。

translations.literal: One length of silk, one wine vessel, one sheep, and one pig each; two grain vessels and two grain bowls each; three libation cups; and ten dishes and ten stands each.
translations.idiomatic: Offerings consisted of one length of silk, one wine vessel, one sheep, and one pig; two grain vessels and two grain bowls; three libation cups; and ten dishes and ten stands.

sentences.zh: 秋獮，王大臣致祭，登一，鉶二，餘同春祭。

translations.literal: At the autumn hunt, princes and great ministers performed sacrifice, with one presentation table and two meat stands; the rest matched the spring sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: At the autumn hunt, princes and great ministers performed sacrifice with one presentation table and two meat stands; all else matched the spring sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 別建廟以祀，錫號協義昭靈。

translations.literal: A separate temple was built for worship, and the title Xiexi Zhaoling was granted.
translations.idiomatic: A separate temple was built for worship, and the title Xiexi Zhaoling (Harmonious Righteousness and Manifest Spirit) was granted.

sentences.zh: 又封江西廬岳神曰溥福廣濟。

translations.literal: Mount Luyue in Jiangxi was further enfeoffed as Pufu Guangji.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Luyue in Jiangxi was further enfeoffed as Pufu Guangji (Broad Blessing and Wide Relief).

sentences.zh: 自仁宗迄德宗，封江南、湖北、山東、台灣、安東、江神、漢神、海神，黃陂木蘭山、西藏瓦合山、四川瓘眉山神，皆以時肇封或崇祀。

translations.literal: From the Renzong Emperor through the Dezong Emperor, spirits in Jiangnan, Hubei, Shandong, Taiwan, Andong, along with river spirits, Han River spirits, and sea spirits, and the spirits of Mount Mulan in Huangpi, Mount Wahe in Tibet, and Mount Guanmei in Sichuan, were all enfeoffed or elevated in worship as the times required.
translations.idiomatic: From Emperor Renzong through Emperor Dezong, spirits in Jiangnan, Hubei, Shandong, Taiwan, and Andong, along with river spirits, Han River spirits, and sea spirits, and the spirits of Mount Mulan in Huangpi, Mount Wahe in Tibet, and Mount Guanmei in Sichuan, were enfeoffed or elevated in worship as occasion demanded.

sentences.zh: 綜稽一代祀典，河神別見河渠篇，其餘名山大川錫號尚多，不悉舉雲。

translations.literal: Surveying the sacrificial canon of the dynasty as a whole, the River Spirit is treated separately in the Treatise on Rivers and Waterways; for other famous mountains and great rivers there were still many granted titles — not all are listed here.
translations.idiomatic: Reviewing the dynasty's sacrificial canon as a whole, the River Spirit is treated separately in the Treatise on Rivers and Waterways; many other famous mountains and great rivers received granted titles as well, and not all are listed here.

sentences.zh: 直省神祇順治初，令各府、川、縣建壇，歲春秋仲月，有司致祭。

translations.literal: For the terrestrial spirits of the provinces: at the beginning of the Shunzhi reign, each prefecture, department, and county was ordered to erect altars; in the middle months of spring and autumn each year, responsible officials performed sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: For provincial terrestrial spirits: at the beginning of Shunzhi, each prefecture, department, and county was ordered to build altars, and in the middle months of spring and autumn each year responsible officials performed sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，定制，有司齋二日，朝服蒞事，儀視社稷壇。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongzheng, regulations were fixed: responsible officials observed two days of abstention, attended in court dress, and the rite followed that of the State Altars.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3, regulations were fixed: responsible officials observed two days of abstention, attended in court dress, and the rite followed that of the State Altars.

sentences.zh: 乾隆八年，頒各省祀神祇祝文。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Qianlong, prayer texts for provincial worship of terrestrial spirits were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 8, prayer texts for provincial worship of terrestrial spirits were promulgated to all provinces.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，定各府、州、縣祭境內山川，以春秋仲月戊日。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, it was ordained that each prefecture, department, and county should sacrifice to mountains and rivers within its jurisdiction on the wu days of the middle months of spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, it was fixed that each prefecture, department, and county should sacrifice to mountains and rivers within its jurisdiction on the wu days of the middle months of spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 其風、雷諸神，特錫封廟號以祀。

translations.literal: As for the wind, thunder, and other such spirits, special titles and temple names were granted for their worship.
translations.idiomatic: As for spirits of wind, thunder, and the like, special titles and temple names were granted for their worship.

sentences.zh: 自世宗至德宗末，代有增錫。

translations.literal: From the Shizong Emperor to the end of the Dezong Emperor's reign, each generation added further grants.
translations.idiomatic: From Emperor Shizong to the end of Emperor Dezong's reign, each generation added further enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 凡列祀典者，有司隨時致虔，用羊一、豬一、果五盤、帛一、尊一、爵三，讀祝叩拜如故事。

translations.literal: For all spirits enrolled in the sacrificial canon, responsible officials offered worship at the appointed times with one sheep, one pig, five trays of fruit, one length of silk, one wine vessel, and three libation cups, reading the prayer and performing prostrations according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: For all spirits enrolled in the sacrificial canon, responsible officials worshipped at the appointed times with one sheep, one pig, five trays of fruit, one length of silk, one wine vessel, and three libation cups, reading the prayer and performing prostrations according to precedent.
